pages.title: Infinity Sky
pages.creator: HyperJoy
pages.description: In Infinity Sky, guide a bouncing character from one platform to the next. Look up before each landing to pick your next platform and stay clear of the monsters. Collect rewards when they are within reach. The platforms keep going, so the challenge is to see how high you can climb.

pages.title: Running Late
pages.creator: Book4ua
pages.description: Running Late is a card game about explaining to your boss why you are late. Play three excuse cards to build your story, then answer the boss's follow-up questions. Each card commits you to a detail. Remember what you said before adding a twist, because a contradiction costs you credibility.

pages.title: Word Search Universe 2
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Word Search Universe 2 hides words in letter grids organized by topic. Swipe across the letters to pick out words about food, science, history or nature. Work through each themed challenge to unlock another chapter. When a word is hard to spot, look for its first letters elsewhere in the grid.

pages.title: Men Vs Gorillas
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description: Men Vs Gorillas pits a human fighter against increasingly tough gorillas. Fight through the levels and use the rewards to improve your damage, strength and health. Pay attention to the next gorilla's attacks before closing in. Build up your fighter as you go so you can take on stronger opponents.

pages.title: Dan the Man
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Dan the Man is an action platformer that follows Dan through an arcade brawl. Fight your way past groups of enemies and use the available weapons when a fight gets crowded. Upgrade Dan's combat skills as you progress. Boss fights give you a chance to put those moves and weapons to use.

pages.title: 2048 - Blocks destruction
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: 2048 - Blocks destruction is a block shooter where bigger numbers give your balls more power. Fire at the blocks and look for chances to pick up more balls. Merge them to increase their values and deal more damage. See how high you can push your score as your shots get stronger.

pages.title: Idle Landmark Builder
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Idle Landmark Builder puts you in charge of construction crews building landmarks from scratch. Hire more workers and upgrade the crew to build faster or earn more income. Watch the structures take shape as the work progresses. The projects include the Eiffel Tower and the pyramids, each with its own construction process.

pages.title: Sprunki Space Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Sprunki Space Challenge is an arcade score game where you bounce off enemies. Use the arrow keys to move and try to hit several enemies before touching the ground to build a combo. Reach the target score before time runs out, then spend your score on upgrades such as Rocket Jump for later levels.

pages.title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon lets you run a panda-themed restaurant. Open more dining tables and improve the kitchen equipment so you can serve more meals. Hire chefs and servers as the business grows. Put the idle income back into the restaurant to improve how quickly food reaches the tables.

pages.title: Hoop Rivals
pages.creator: Iamgronig
pages.description: Hoop Rivals turns the basketball hoop into the character you control. Move, spin and bounce to get your rim underneath the ball before a rival gets there. Follow the ball after each bounce and be ready to change direction. Compete in fast matches where several hoops are all chasing the same ball.

pages.title: Stickman Punishment
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Stickman Punishment follows a stickman who gains the power to change shape after a radiation blast. When his friend betrays him, he puts that power to use in a series of revenge scenes. Choose a punishment with the on-screen buttons and watch how each transformation plays out.

pages.title: Stack n Sort
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Stack n Sort is a puzzle about arranging colored hoops on posts. Move rings between stacks and bring matching colors together. Check which ring will be left on top before moving another one, since it can block access to the colors beneath it. Keep sorting until the hoops are grouped by color.

pages.title: Roblox Halloween Costume Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Roblox Halloween Costume Party gives you Roblox-inspired pieces for a Halloween outfit. Mix costumes and accessories to make a spooky character or try a more playful combination. Compare the pieces on your character before settling on a look. Take your finished costume to the party and see how it stands out in the contest.

pages.title: My Farm Empire
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: My Farm Empire starts you on an island with room to build a farm. Grow crops such as vegetables, fruit, herbs and flowers as you work on the land. Decide what to grow next as the farm develops. Each new crop gives you another way to use the space on the island.

pages.title: Match Master
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Match Master is a timed puzzle where you find matching objects in a pile. Drag identical pairs into the round hatch to clear them. Use power-ups when you need help finding a match before time runs out. Spend the coins you earn on decorations, and keep clearing boards to unlock more houses.

pages.title: Number Tricky Puzzles
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Number Tricky Puzzles asks you to sort matching coins into the same slot. Press the merge button to turn a group into a higher-level coin. Check where you have space before moving more coins, especially when a slot is waiting for a match. Keep combining them as you work toward level ten.

pages.title: Helpful Nail
pages.creator: The Abyss Brain
pages.description: Helpful Nail gives you control of a nail while a hammer strikes it. Try to keep it straight by bringing it back toward the center between hits. Watch how much it leans and correct it before the next blow. Build a combo and see how high you can take your score.

pages.title: Fish Eat Getting Big
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fish Eat Getting Big is an ocean game where fish grow by eating smaller fish. Check the numbers to see what you can eat safely and steer clear of anything larger. As your fish grows, more prey comes within reach. Share the game with friends for up to three players.

pages.title: CHICK CHICKEN CONNECT
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: CHICK CHICKEN CONNECT lets you clear panels by linking at least three of the same type. Each link uses a turn, so look for longer chains that can earn a bomb and extend the run. Clearing chickens fills the skill gauge, while clearing chicks fills the fever gauge. Keep making chains before your turns run out.

pages.title: Spot 5 Differences Camping
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spot 5 Differences Camping shows two versions of a camping picture. Look for five details that changed and tap them as you find them. Use a hint if one of the differences is hard to spot. Finish quickly to earn a bonus for the time you have left.

pages.title: Drift F1
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Drift F1 is a timing game about getting a car around tight bends on a bumpy track. Tap and release to control each drift and stay on the course. Look ahead for the next turn before reaching it. Pick up gold coins along the way and spend them on cars in the garage.

pages.title: Crazy Dunk
pages.creator: MX Media & Entertainment Pte. Ltd
pages.description: Crazy Dunk turns basketball into a tap-to-bounce arcade game. Tap to keep the ball moving and time the bounces so it reaches the basket. Watch how high the ball is before you tap again. Keep making baskets and use the next bounce to line up another shot.

pages.title: Imperor.io
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Imperor.io is a single-player strategy game about expanding a kingdom one territory at a time. Take opposing lands to earn gold, then use it to upgrade your castle and train troops faster. Buy more troops when you need to reinforce the next attack. Conquer all the opposing territories to win.

pages.title: Ellie And Ben Fall Date
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ellie And Ben Fall Date lets you help Ellie get ready after Ben asks her out. Browse her wardrobe and try different pieces before deciding what she should wear. Put together a look for the fall date, then change any items you want until the outfit works as a whole.

pages.title: JumpyPig
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: JumpyPig asks you to keep a pig jumping from one platform to the next. Watch where the platforms are moving, since they come in different sizes and travel in different directions. Aim for the middle of each one to score more points. Stay on screen and avoid falling between platforms.

pages.title: Slime Warrior Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slime Warrior Run sends a hero through the city collecting slime to build up his power. Guide him toward the pickups until he transforms into the Slime Warrior. In that form he can withstand bullets and lift tanks. Use the transformation to deal with threats that would otherwise stop his run.

pages.title: My Dear Boss
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: My Dear Boss is a launch game where you time a kick to send an abusive boss out the window. Watch for the right moment before you make the kick. A better-timed hit sends him farther, so adjust when you act on the next attempt and see how far you can launch him.

pages.title: Bricks Breaker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bricks Breaker asks you to aim a volley at bricks with numbered hit counts. Choose an angle that lets the balls bounce into as many bricks as possible. A brick breaks when its count reaches zero. Clear the board before any bricks reach the bottom to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Masha and the Bear: Meadows
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Masha and the Bear: Meadows is a territory game where you draw a trail by leaving your lawn. Return to your own ground to claim the area inside the loop. If a rival crosses the trail before you return, your run ends. Watch for openings to cross their trails while protecting your own.

pages.title: Julias Food Truck
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Julias Food Truck puts you behind the counter of Julia's burger truck. Read each customer's order and assemble the burger they asked for before they run out of patience. Work quickly while checking the ingredients. Serving the right burgers on time keeps customers happy and can earn you a bigger payment.

pages.title: Squid Hidden Signs
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Squid Hidden Signs asks you to find symbols that fade into the pictures. Scan each scene carefully and click a sign when you see it. Look at the small details near edges and objects, where a faint mark is easy to miss. There are ten signs to find in each of eight levels.

pages.title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 2 asks you to clear cards one rank higher or lower than the current card. Draw another card if the board has no match. Clear five in a row to earn extra cards and try to finish before the deck runs out. Collect stars and bonuses to unlock new areas and card sets.

pages.title: Dark World
pages.creator: TGamesStudio
pages.description: Dark World sends you through thirty platform levels on a search for an escape. Jump between ledges and use your sword to attack up close or throw it at an enemy from farther away. Look around the different platforms for useful items. A route you pass on the first attempt may make the level easier to finish.

pages.title: Get the Stars
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Get the Stars is a puzzle about clearing each area of stars before moving on. Plan a route that takes you to every star, then collect the key that unlocks the next challenge. Look at the layout before setting off so you can reach any stars tucked away from the main path.

pages.title: Xtreme Racing
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Xtreme Racing puts you in a first-person aircraft racing through an endless course. Steer through narrow canyons and around the abstract obstacles as they come toward you. Look ahead for the next opening so you can line up in time. Collect extra points on each run to build your total score.

pages.title: Pig Escape
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Pig Escape is a puzzle where you launch a pig from one landing spot to another. Pick an angle that gets it past spikes and toward the stars. Collect the required star to open the escape hole, then work out how to reach it. There are twenty-five levels with different routes to solve.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 3
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Kingdom of Ninja 3 sends a ninja past flying and crawling monsters across fifteen levels. Watch their movement as you choose when to cross the next stretch. Keep clear of the enemies and find your way through each layout. Survive one level to see what the next part of the kingdom throws at you.

pages.title: MANEUVER
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: MANEUVER is a one-button arcade game where you reverse the ball's direction with a tap or click. Watch the obstacles near its path and choose when to turn back so it can pass safely. Each successful move keeps the run going and gives you a chance to improve your score.

pages.title: Home House Painter
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Home House Painter gives you walls with white spaces left to cover. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move the paint across the surface. Look for a route that takes you through the small gaps as well as the larger areas. Cover all the white patches to finish the wall.

pages.title: Jumbled Puzzle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jumbled Puzzle asks you to rebuild a picture by swapping its pieces. Look at which details continue across the edges to work out where each block belongs. Finish before time runs out to move through the levels. Progress opens more themes, mystery boxes and bonus puzzles to try.

pages.title: Merge Fish
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Merge Fish is a puzzle about combining smaller fish into larger ones. Place fish where they can form a match with the same kind. Watch the space in the reservoir, because the run ends when it fills. Keep merging to make room for new fish and discover bigger ones.

pages.title: Quizzland trivia game. Lite version
pages.creator: MNO GO APPS LTD
pages.description: Quizzland trivia game. Lite version is a solo quiz with easy, normal and hard difficulty options. Pick an answer and read the explanation afterward to learn more about the topic. Move through the questions at your own pace and try a different difficulty when you want to test another part of your general knowledge.

pages.title: Black Thrones
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Black Thrones sends an assassin named Black along a wall full of undead. Jump over barriers, slide underneath them and take down enemies blocking your path. Collect coins during the run to improve the power-ups you find along the wall. Keep moving through the hazards to raise your score.

pages.title: Basketball Legends 2020
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Basketball Legends 2020 lets you pick a team for a tournament against the computer or a quick match with a friend. Shoot three-pointers, dunk and block the other player's attempts. Watch the special-shot meter as you play. When it fills, you can use a powerful dunk to finish an attack.

pages.title: Royal Dress Up Queen Fashion
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Royal Dress Up Queen Fashion gives you six dolls and more than 150 clothing items to try. Choose a royal outfit, then add pieces such as a crown, mantle or scepter. Try a red ensemble or work with another color. Compare the different combinations as you design a look for each queen.

pages.title: Fish World Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Fish World Puzzle gives you underwater pictures to put together. Use the colors, shapes and details of the fish to work out where neighboring pieces belong. Build around the sections you recognize first and use their edges to place the rest. Finish one picture to see the full underwater scene.

pages.title: Supra Racing Speed Turbo Drift
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Supra Racing Speed Turbo Drift mixes racing with drifting around corners. Stay ahead of fast opponents while earning points that convert into experience. Use your progress to buy cars, change their colors and open more races. Try a different setup as you get used to holding a drift through the turns.

pages.title: Chaki Food Drop
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Chaki Food Drop asks you to catch falling food. Move Chaki into position for fruit and other edible items, then get clear of knives and bombs. Check what is falling before moving beneath it. Keep eating the good drops and leave yourself room to dodge the objects that would stop the run.

pages.title: Dangerous Turn
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Dangerous Turn is a one-touch driving game about keeping a car away from the edge of the road. Click or tap to change its direction as it approaches a bend. The car speeds up as you go, so watch the next turn early. Touching the roadside ends the run.

pages.title: Military Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Military Trucks Coloring gives you eight military truck illustrations to color. Pick a truck and use the mouse or your finger to apply colors. Choose different shades for the cab, wheels and the rest of the vehicle, or use a coordinated palette. Switch pictures to try another truck design.

pages.title: Exotic Birds Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Exotic Birds Coloring offers eight bird pictures and 23 colors. Pick a bird and fill in its feathers and surroundings with the shades you want. The game gives you a score based on how quickly you finish. Save a copy of the picture once you have a color combination you like.

pages.title: Dont Get Caught
pages.creator: NA
pages.description: Dont Get Caught puts you behind the wheel with the police in pursuit. Use the arrow keys to drive and look for money along the route. Decide when a pickup is worth going after while you keep the police off your tail. Spend what you collect on a stronger car for another run.

pages.title: Supercars Speed Race
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Supercars Speed Race is a 3D racing game where better times unlock more cars and tracks. Pick a supercar and use the arrow keys to drive, with Space for the brake. Work on taking corners cleanly to improve your time. Compare your best records with other drivers in the worldwide rankings.

pages.title: Military Vehicles Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Military Vehicles Jigsaw lets you assemble twelve pictures of military vehicles. Choose a 25-, 49- or 100-piece layout for the image you want. Look for distinctive details in the vehicles and use them to join neighboring pieces. A higher piece count breaks those details into smaller parts to work out.

pages.title: Shift Run
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shift Run is an arcade movement game built around changing your angle and direction. Click and hold the left mouse button to make the shift. Watch the path as the character runs, jumps and rolls through the course. Time the change so you can keep going into the next stunt.

pages.title: Motorbike Simulator Stunt Racing
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Motorbike Simulator Stunt Racing gives you a motorcycle for stunt riding. Drive with WASD and use Space for the handbrake when you need to slow down. Pick a line for a jump and get the bike in position before accelerating. Try different approaches to the high jumps and desert stunts.

pages.title: Fruit Link Deluxe
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Fruit Link Deluxe asks you to connect matching fruit to meet a goal on each board. Use the mouse to link items such as strawberries and watermelons. Check which fruit the level still needs before making another chain. Work through the goals as the mix of fruit changes from one board to the next.

pages.title: Extreme Car Racing Simulation Game 2019
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Extreme Car Racing Simulation Game 2019 gives you a track for high-speed driving and stunts. Watch the dashboard for your speed, gear and engine revs as you get the car up to pace. The car can take damage when you crash. Try different approaches to a stunt and see how the vehicle handles each one.

pages.title: Block Craft Survival
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Block Craft Survival is a physics puzzle about bringing a miner down safely. Click or tap blocks to destroy them and watch how the remaining structure shifts. Look at what each block is supporting before you remove it. Choose an order that gives the miner a safe place to land.

pages.title: Daily Russian Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Daily Russian Jigsaw gives you pictures of Russian landscapes and buildings to piece together. Pick one of three difficulty levels and find pieces with edges or details that continue into each other. Work through the image with the mouse or touch controls. See how quickly you can finish the picture.

pages.title: FZ Tripolygon
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: FZ Tripolygon is a color-matching reaction game. Rotate the triangle until the side facing the line matches its color. Check which color is coming before turning so you can make the match in time. Keep the triangle lined up through successive color changes and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Zombie Walker
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Zombie Walker is a route puzzle where you guide a zombie to a jar of brains. Infect people along the way, but steer clear of the police. There is one route that earns all three stars in each level. Look over the layout before moving and see if you can find it across twenty challenges.

pages.title: EG Flappy Bounce
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Flappy Bounce is an arcade game where you keep a ball aloft with clicks or taps. Time each bounce to pass through the gaps between the upper and lower pipes. Watch the next opening as soon as you clear one. Keep the ball clear of the pipes to build your score.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Goes Sick
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Goes Sick follows Hazel after she wakes up with a fever, cold and cough. Help her get to the doctor and stay with her through the checkup. Use the mouse to respond to what she needs as the visit continues. Keep her comfortable while the doctor looks after her.

pages.title: Snow Track Racing 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Snow Track Racing 3D puts you in a formula car on snow-covered asphalt. Steer with WASD and get used to the way the car drifts through a turn. Leave enough room to correct the slide before the next corner. Keep the car on the course as you work through the race.

pages.title: BTS Sweet Monsters Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Sweet Monsters Coloring gives you monster outlines to fill with color. Pick a shade and apply it with the mouse or by tapping. Try different colors on the monster's features, then choose a palette for the rest of the picture. Move on to another monster when you want a different design.

pages.title: Stock Boxes
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Stock Boxes is a warehouse stacking game where you use a forklift to place incoming boxes. Line up each box with the stack so it lands securely. Look at the balance before placing another one. If the boxes are badly positioned, they can fall and bring the game to an end.

pages.title: Ice Slushy Maker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ice Slushy Maker lets you make and decorate a frozen drink. Choose a flavor, cut the fruit and prepare the ice before mixing the slushy. Fill a cup and pick how to decorate it, then add a straw. Try another flavor or cup design when you make the next drink.

pages.title: Baby Hazel New Born Baby
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel New Born Baby follows Hazel as she waits for her mother to bring her new baby brother home. Click to interact with Hazel and the family as they welcome him. Follow what happens around the house and help Hazel take part in the activities as she gets to know the baby.

pages.title: Emergency Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Emergency Trucks Match 3 is a matching game with emergency vehicles. Line up three or more of the same truck to score points. Good matches can add time to the round, and you can pause when you need to study the board. Look for useful groups before the time runs out.

pages.title: Johnny Trigger Online
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Johnny Trigger Online is an on-rails shooter where you fight monsters as the game moves you through each area. Aim at enemies when they come into view and take them out as you advance. Watch for another target after each shot. Clear the threats along the route to reach safety.

pages.title: Pixel Shooter.IO
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pixel Shooter.IO lets you customize a blocky fighter and compete against other players online. Choose weapons for Deathmatch or enter Battle Royale and try to be the last fighter alive. Keep track of where opponents can approach from as you move across the map. Choose a weapon that suits your next fight.

pages.title: Happy Princesses Pregnant Bffs
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Happy Princesses Pregnant Bffs follows two friends getting ready to become mothers. Help them take their vitamins, choose healthy food and play music through headphones for the babies. Once the care activities are done, pick a dress and hairstyle for each princess. Give both friends a look for the rest of their day.

pages.title: Money Detector Pound Sterling
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Money Detector Pound Sterling asks you to find seven differences between two pictures of a British banknote. Look closely at details on the £5, £10, £20 and £50 notes as you work through five levels. Mark each difference you spot. Find them all across the levels to earn fifteen stars.

pages.title: Ellie Mermaid Vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Ellie Mermaid Vs Princess gives Ellie two roles to dress for, a mermaid and a princess. Put together an outfit for each version of her before their special events. Try pieces that suit each setting and compare the finished looks. Then decide which version of Ellie's style you prefer.

pages.title: Mandala Maker Online
pages.creator: YO-YOgames
pages.description: Mandala Maker Online is a drawing tool for creating mandalas. Build a design by working from the center and adding shapes around it. Try different arrangements as you develop the pattern. Once you have a design you want to keep, save it as an image or start another mandala.

pages.title: Princess Winter Shopping Online
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Winter Shopping Online lets you help Elsa and Moana update their wardrobes from home. Browse the winter fashion choices and try them on the two princesses. Put together a look for each one, then see which pieces work best together. Change individual items before settling on their outfits.

pages.title: eSport Gamer Tycoon
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: eSport Gamer Tycoon is a clicker about working toward a career as a professional gamer. Tap to make progress and build up your character as you move through the competition. Work your way toward winning the leagues. Keep advancing through the game to see how far you can take your esports career.

pages.title: Lappa Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Lappa Connect is a mahjong connection puzzle. Find two tiles with the same picture and connect them along an open route. Clear a pair to make space for other connections. Look around the edges when the middle of the board is crowded, and keep matching until there are no tiles left.

pages.title: Save The Dodos
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Save The Dodos is a rescue puzzle where you rearrange the terrain to guide walking birds to an exit. Move tiles to open safe paths and use the way the edges wrap around to reach another part of the board. Free trapped dodos when you find them and get as many birds out as you can.

pages.title: Super Stacker 2
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Super Stacker 2 is a physics puzzle where you build a stable stack from different shapes. Place each piece where it can support what comes next. Think about how shapes might tip or roll before setting them down. Get all the pieces onto the stack and keep them from falling.

pages.title: Wedding Perfect MakeUp
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Wedding Perfect MakeUp lets you prepare a bride's makeup and outfit. Apply foundation, then choose eye shadow, lipstick and blush. Adjust the lashes and compare the colors before picking clothes to go with the finished makeup. Change details until the look works together for the wedding.

pages.title: Ellie Cover Magazine
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Ellie Cover Magazine puts you in charge of styling Ellie for three magazine covers. Choose clothes for each shoot, then match the shoes, accessories and hairstyle to the outfit. Try a different style from one cover to the next. Use the finished looks to give each photo session its own character.
